get.summary: Roll-call roster of a section for a date (and period)
get.description: Staff only. Returns the section’s active students (roll order) with any saved marks; students on approved leave are pre-filled as `leave` (`source: "leave"`). `canSubmit`/`blockedReason` say whether the caller may submit right now (future date, non-working day, holiday, edit window, not the class teacher / period teacher). In `period` mode `periodId` is required. A section outside the caller’s classes is 404.

put.summary: Submit (or re-submit) the whole roll call of a section — idempotent upsert
put.description: Daily mode: the class teacher (or school scope) marks the section; period mode: the period’s teacher / class teacher / school scope, with `periodId`. List every student, or pass `defaultStatus` for the unlisted ones (students on approved leave become `leave`). Never for a future date, non-working day or holiday. Teachers may re-submit within `attendance.editWindowHours` of the first submission (and take a missed roll call until the end of that date + the window); afterwards 403 `EDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED` — use a correction request. Administrators with `attendance:edit` at school scope may override. When `attendance.notifyParentsOnAbsent` is on, verified guardians of newly absent students get an `attendance.absent` notification after the commit. Audited.

post.summary: Ask for a correction of a submitted attendance record (after the edit window)
post.description: Only teachers who may mark that section. One pending request per record (409 `CORRECTION_PENDING`). The class teacher — or school-level approvers when the class teacher asks — is notified.

get.summary: Correction requests (default: pending)
get.description: Approvers see requests for sections they lead (class teachers) or all sections (school scope); teachers without approval rights see only their own (`mine`).

post.summary: Approve a correction: applies the change, audits before/after and notifies the student and verified guardians
post.description: Class teacher of that section or school scope (404 otherwise). The requester cannot approve their own request unless they hold school scope (403 `SELF_APPROVAL`).

post.summary: Reject a correction (a note is required); the requester is notified

get.summary: A student’s attendance summary: counts, percentage, month-by-month, shortage flag
get.description: Students: themselves; parents: verified-linked children; teachers: students of their classes; school scope: anyone. Anyone else is 404. Percentage = (present + late + ½·half_day) / (present + absent + late + half_day); approved `leave` days are excluded. `from`/`to` default to the academic year start / today. `shortage.isShort` compares with the school’s `attendance.shortagePercent`.

get.summary: A student’s attendance history (newest first, keyset pagination)
Section attendance over a date range: per-day counts and per-student percentages (staff)
get.description: Defaults to the last 30 days. Only submitted roll calls count. Teachers: their own sections; school scope: any.

get.summary: School-wide attendance for a day (management dashboard)
get.description: Totals, % present, per-section table (marked or not), absentee list and a short trend. SQL aggregation over indexed columns — stays fast with hundreds of thousands of records.

get.summary: Today’s attendance shaped for the role dashboards
get.description: Teachers: the sections (daily mode) or period slots (period mode) I take attendance for today, with `marked` and `pendingCount` for the “not yet marked” list. Students/parents: today’s status per (linked) child. Management: school snapshot. Empty `items` on non-working days and holidays.

get.summary: CSV export of attendance records (max 93 days per file)

post.summary: Run the attendance shortage scan now (management)
post.description: Same scan as the daily job: students below `attendance.shortagePercent` since the academic year started get one alert per month (guardians notified, `attendance.shortage`). Safe to call repeatedly.

get.summary: Student leave requests visible to me (pending first)
get.description: Students: their own; parents: their verified-linked children only (never other families); teachers: students of their classes; school scope: all. `from`/`to` select requests overlapping the range.

post.summary: Apply for leave for a student (parent for a linked child, or the student)
post.description: Parents with several children must pass `studentId` (422 `STUDENT_REQUIRED`); a child that is not verified-linked is 404. Max 60 days, may start up to 30 days in the past, must include a school day (422 `NO_WORKING_DAYS`), must not overlap a pending/approved request (409 `LEAVE_OVERLAP`). The class teacher is notified.

get.summary: One leave request (out-of-scope → 404)

post.summary: Approve a leave request
post.description: The class teacher of the student’s section or a school-scope approver (other teachers: 403 `NOT_CLASS_TEACHER`). With `attendance.leaveMarksAttendance`, attendance is marked `leave` for the school days (existing roll calls updated; in daily mode drafts are created for days without one). Notifies the student and verified guardians (`leave.decided`). Audited.

post.summary: Reject a leave request (a note is required)
Cancel my pending leave request
post.description: Only the person who applied, while it is pending.

post.summary: Check out for today (self-service)
post.description: 409 `NOT_CHECKED_IN` / `ALREADY_CHECKED_OUT`.

get.description: Published, not-expired announcements whose audience includes me (students: their user type / role / grade / section; parents: their verified children’s grades / sections and the parent audience; staff: by role / user type). Each item carries my read / acknowledged flags.

Take a scheduled announcement back to a plain draft
Publish a draft now and notify its audience (`announcement.new`)

Events & holidays I can see
get.description: Events whose audience includes me (published or cancelled), plus drafts I created; school-scope editors also see every draft. Without `from`/`to` only upcoming and ongoing events are listed. For events that ask for registration or consent, `children` lists the caller’s children with their answer so far.

post.summary: Create an event / holiday / PTM / sports day (draft, or published at once with `publish: true`)
post.description: Teachers (assigned scope) may only address sections they lead or teach. `registrationRequired` asks parents for going / not going per child; `consentRequired` (with `consentText`) asks for permission per child. `capacity` limits positive answers; `registrationDeadline` closes answers. `onlineMeeting: { provider: "zoom" | "google" }` adds a Zoom / Google Meet meeting (needs a start and end time on ONE day and a connected provider; created when the event is published, updated when the day, time or title change, cancelled with the event). A provider failure never blocks saving: the event answers with `onlineMeeting.status = "failed"` and can be retried.

get.summary: Zoom / Google Meet providers the school has connected and switched on (what an event or meeting form may offer), and its default
One event (with response counts for its organisers)

patch.summary: Edit an event (creator, or school-scope editor); changed date / time / place of a published event notifies the audience

delete.summary: Delete a draft event (or, with events:delete, a published one that has no responses)

post.summary: Publish a draft event and notify its audience (`event.new`)
Cancel an event (kept on the calendar as cancelled; the audience is notified)
Retry the event’s online meeting after a failure (create, update or cancel at Zoom / Google Meet)
post.description: Only while `onlineMeeting.status` is `failed`; 409 ONLINE_MEETING_NOT_FAILED otherwise. The result (success or a new safe error) is in the returned event. Failed meetings are also retried automatically every few minutes for a day.

post.summary: Register for an event / give or deny consent, for one child (own child for students, linked child for parents)
post.description: Registration events accept `going` / `not_going`; consent events accept `consent_given` / `consent_denied` (parents only). Answers can be changed until the deadline. Errors: 409 EVENT_FULL, REGISTRATION_CLOSED, EVENT_ENDED, EVENT_CANCELLED; 422 NO_RESPONSE_REQUIRED, RESPONSE_NOT_ALLOWED.

get.summary: Organisers: answers per child (`response=pending` lists children who have not answered)
Calendar feed: events, holidays, exam papers and homework due dates for me (max 100 days)
get.description: Each item has a `kind`: holiday | event | ptm | sports | exam | other (school events), exam_paper (grade of the student / children; exams that are no longer drafts), homework_due (published homework of my sections). Parents can pass `studentId` to narrow exam papers and homework to one child.

get.summary: Parent–teacher meetings I can see

post.summary: Upload a file (multipart: field `file`, plus `purpose`)
post.description: Send `multipart/form-data` with a `file` part. `purpose` may be a query parameter or a form field — as a form field it must come BEFORE the `file` part. The content type is decided from the file bytes (not the client-declared type) and must be on the allow-list for the purpose: avatar → JPEG/PNG/WebP (max 5 MB); every other purpose → images (JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF/HEIC) and documents (PDF, DOC/DOCX, XLS/XLSX, PPT/PPTX, TXT, CSV). Executables, scripts, HTML/SVG and macro-enabled Office files are always refused. The size limit is the school-wide upload limit (default 15 MB). Who may upload which purpose: avatar/other → any signed-in user; homework → homework:create|edit; submission → submissions:create; material → materials:create|edit; document → student_documents:create | leave:create | admissions:create | students:edit; announcement → announcements|events create|edit; receipt → payments|expenses|fees create. Use the returned `attachment` object as an element of the `attachments` arrays of homework, submissions, announcements.

purpose.description: send BEFORE `file`, or use the ?purpose= query parameter

get.summary: Download / stream a file
get.description: Streams the bytes with the detected `Content-Type`, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Cache-Control: private` and an `ETag` (sha-256). Supports a single `Range: bytes=a-b` request. Images and PDFs are `inline`, everything else `attachment` (use `?download=1` to force a download). Callers who may not see the file get 404.

delete.summary: Delete a file (soft delete)
delete.description: The uploader or a school administrator (settings:edit at school scope) may delete. The uploader cannot delete a file that is still attached to a record (409 FILE_IN_USE). The bytes are purged after 30 days.
